pages.text: Akaishi Satiation Charm (charm slot, 500k buffer): when saturation drops below 5, restores +0.1 saturation every tick.

Akaishi Antidote Bracelet (bracelet slot, 200k buffer): immediately cures poison for 500 energy per use.$(br2)$(bold)Akaishi Wither Charm$(reset) (belt slot, 200k buffer): immediately cures wither for 1000 energy per use.$(br2)Together they remove these debuffs as soon as they are applied.
Shared mechanics and the slot map are in the $(l:akaishi:curios)Akaishi Trinkets$(/l) overview; they are powered by the $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cell$(/l).
